records.title: Amtrak's June 2026 reports publish incompatible PIDS completion inventories
records.finding: Amtrak's ADA report lists 93 completed PIDS deployments while its Accessible Canada Act report lists 117 completed PIDS installations for the same April 2026 reporting horizon.
records.denominator: Two Amtrak accessibility reports dated June 2026, preserving the 93-deployment and 117-installation labels as separate unresolved inventories rather than merging them.
evidence_limits: The reports do not define whether deployments and installations cover different scopes, stations, devices, or closeout states.

The 24-record difference prevents a single PIDS completion denominator without a published crosswalk.
